login.title: Log in
login.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
login.twoFactorText: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.recoveryHint: No access to your app? Enter one of your recovery codes instead.
login.expired: The login has expired. Please start again.
login.forgotHint: Forgot your password? An administrator can reset it.
password.mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
password.tooShort: The password must be at least 10 characters long.
password.mustChangeText: Your password was reset. Please choose your own new password to continue.
palette.title: Search
view.label: View
sort.label: Sort order
sort.title: A–Z
arrange.hint: Drag the handles to reorder bookmarks and categories, or to move a bookmark into another category.
arrange.needsManual: Arranging works in “Custom order” without a filter.
arrange.notOwner: Only the owner or an administrator can move this bookmark to another category.
dnd.instructions: Press Space or Enter to pick up. Use the arrow keys to move, Space or Enter to drop, Escape to cancel.
empty.title: No bookmarks yet
empty.text: Add your first bookmark or import the bookmarks from your browser.
bookmark.title: Title
bookmark.titleHint: If left empty, the address is used.
bookmark.sharedHint: All users can see this bookmark.
bookmark.privateHint: Only you can see this bookmark.
bookmark.brokenHint: The link did not work at the last check ({code}).
bookmark.deleteConfirm: “{title}” will be deleted for all users.
category.name: Category name
category.deleteConfirm: Delete the category “{name}”? Its bookmarks are kept and become uncategorised.
icon.urlHint: Address of an image or of a page whose icon should be used.
icon.tooLarge: The image is too large (max. 500 KB).
icon.notFound: No icon found – the letter icon is used.
icon.status.found: Icon loaded automatically from the website.
icon.status.fallback: Only a fallback icon was found.
icon.status.none: No icon found – the letter icon is used.
icon.status.unknown: The icon has not been loaded yet.
link.unknown: The link could not be checked clearly. It will be checked again later.
theme.label: Theme
twofa.title: Two-factor login
twofa.desc: Protects your account with a code from an authenticator app in addition to your password.
twofa.step1: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (e.g. Aegis, 2FAS, Google Authenticator or the iPhone password app).
twofa.step2: Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app.
twofa.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
twofa.manual: Cannot scan? Enter the key manually
twofa.recoveryText: Keep these codes in a safe place, e.g. your password manager. Each code works once if you no longer have your phone.
import.title: Import and export
import.desc: Import bookmarks from your browser (HTML file) or from a BookmarkHub export (JSON). Folders become categories, duplicates are skipped.
import.howto: Chrome/Edge: Bookmark manager → ⋮ → Export bookmarks. Firefox: Bookmarks → Manage bookmarks → Import and Backup → Export to HTML. Safari: File → Export → Bookmarks.
import.nothing: No bookmarks found in this file.
import.unreadable: The file could not be read.
users.title: Users
users.deleteConfirm: Delete the user “{name}”? Their bookmarks are kept.
users.newPasswordHint: Leave empty to keep the password. With a new password the user must choose their own at the next login.
jobs.title: Maintenance
jobs.faviconsDesc: Fetches the icons of all bookmarks again from the websites.
jobs.linksDesc: Checks whether the bookmarked pages can still be reached. Runs automatically once a week.
backups.title: Backups
backups.desc: A backup is created automatically every day. The last 14 daily and 8 weekly backups are kept.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
